feature: UX Feedback Loop - Visual Annotation System
workflow_rationale: New functionality - visual annotation layer with task creation pipeline, requires new components, stores, and MCP integration

phases.name: Setup & Types
phases.description: Install agentation package and create TypeScript type definitions

subtasks.notes: Installed agentation@2.2.1 successfully without peer dependency conflicts

Created comprehensive annotation types including Annotation, AnnotationSeverity, AnnotationStatus, AnnotationCoordinates, AnnotationViewport, AnnotationFormData, and IPC-related types. Added export to types/index.ts.
Added ANNOTATION_SUBMIT, ANNOTATION_GET, ANNOTATION_DELETE, and ANNOTATION_LIST IPC channels in the Feedback section

phases.name: State Management
phases.description: Create Zustand annotation store for managing annotation state

subtasks.description: Create Zustand annotation store with toggle, add, and clear actions
subtasks.notes: Created annotation-store.ts following kanban-settings-store pattern. Includes isAnnotationMode state, annotations array, and draftAnnotation. Actions: toggleAnnotationMode/setAnnotationMode for mode control, createDraftAnnotation for starting new annotation, submitDraftAnnotation for completing with form data, cancelDraftAnnotation for discarding draft, addAnnotation/updateAnnotation/deleteAnnotation for CRUD operations, clearAnnotations for resetting state, and query methods getAnnotation/getAnnotationsCountByStatus/getAnnotationsCountBySeverity. Includes localStorage persistence for annotation mode, validates coordinates and description length.

phases.name: Spec Generation Service
phases.description: Create service to transform annotations into spec folder structure

subtasks.description: Create annotation-to-spec service with folder creation and file generation
subtasks.notes: Created annotation-to-spec-service.ts with AnnotationToSpecService class. Features: slugify() for URL-friendly folder names, generateSpecId() using first 8 chars of annotation UUID, generateSpecMd() for complete spec document with overview/details/screen context/workflow/task scope/requirements, generateRequirementsJson() for annotation metadata, saveScreenshot() from base64 data, validateAnnotation() with checks for ID/description length/screenshot/coordinates, createSpecFromAnnotation() main method that creates spec folder with all files, specExists() helper, deleteSpec() for cleanup. Follows patterns from project-store.ts (async/await, atomicWriteFile, error handling, singleton export).

phases.name: IPC & MCP Integration
phases.description: Add IPC handlers and MCP tools for annotation operations

subtasks.description: Create annotation IPC handlers for create, list, and delete operations
subtasks.notes: Created annotation-handlers.ts with handlers for ANNOTATION_SUBMIT (create with optional spec generation), ANNOTATION_GET (get by ID), ANNOTATION_LIST (list with filtering), and ANNOTATION_DELETE (delete with optional spec cleanup). Storage uses JSON file in userData. Integrated with AnnotationToSpecService for spec generation. Added validation for annotation payloads. Registered in index.ts with import and setup call.

subtasks.description: Add create_annotation_task MCP tool to existing MCP server
subtasks.notes: Added create_annotation_task MCP tool with Zod schema validation (element_selector, annotation_type, message, priority, context). Implemented handler with rate limiting, unique task ID generation, and IPC notification to renderer. Updated tool count from 5 to 6. Follows existing patterns with proper error handling.

phases.name: UI Components
phases.description: Create React components for annotation overlay, form, list, and toggle

subtasks.description: Create annotation component types and initial barrel export
subtasks.notes: Created types.ts with Annotation, AnnotationCoordinates, ViewportSize, AnnotationSeverity, AnnotationOverlayProps, and AnnotationFormProps types. Created index.ts barrel export following context/index.ts pattern. All type definitions include JSDoc comments and follow the spec's annotation data schema.

subtasks.description: Create AnnotationOverlay component for visual selection
subtasks.notes: Created AnnotationOverlay.tsx with full-screen overlay, click-drag selection, visual feedback (selection rectangle with dimensions), touch support, automatic screenshot capture via window.electronAPI.capture(), Escape key to cancel, minimum selection size validation (20px), crosshair cursor, user hints. Follows RateLimitModal.tsx patterns for code style, i18n usage, and error handling. Follows ResizablePanels.tsx patterns for mouse/touch drag event handling. Exported via annotations/index.ts barrel.

subtasks.description: Create AnnotationForm component for description and severity input
subtasks.notes: Created AnnotationForm.tsx dialog component following FeedbackDialog.tsx pattern. Features: screenshot preview with dimensions badge, required description textarea with character count validation (min 10 chars), severity selector (low/medium/high/critical) with color-coded dot indicators, form validation with visual error feedback, loading state with Loader2 spinner during submission, cancel support with isSubmitting guard, i18n translation keys (dialogs:annotation.*), proper error handling with user-friendly messages, cn() utility for conditional classes, useEffect hook to reset form when new selection is made. Exported via annotations/index.ts barrel.

subtasks.description: Create AnnotationList component to display session annotations
subtasks.notes: Created AnnotationList.tsx following ChatHistorySidebar.tsx pattern. Features: display list of annotations grouped by status, status filter dropdown, multi-select mode with SelectAll/Clear links, inline editing of annotation descriptions, screenshot thumbnail preview with dimensions, severity indicator with color-coded badges, delete confirmation dialogs (single and bulk), regenerate spec option for failed annotations, timestamp formatting with relative time (Just now, Xm ago, Xh ago, Xd ago), proper i18n translation keys (annotationList:* namespace), error display for failed annotations, component/route metadata display, spec ID display for completed annotations. Exported via annotations/index.ts barrel.
